meta.name: 中式英语（Chinglish）常见错误模式库
meta.purpose: 面向马来西亚中国留学生的学术写作辅导：识别中式英语病灶，给出学术英语改法
meta.positioning: 写作辅导工具（帮助学生自己修改），非代写

patterns.wrong: In my opinion, I think that...
patterns.issue: 观点引导语叠加，两种表态词重复，属中式冗余习惯（中文常说『在我看来，我认为』）
patterns.suggestion: 直接用 I argue / I contend / This paper argues，或删去引导语让论点自己说话

patterns.wrong: very very important / extremely extremely useful
patterns.issue: 用副词叠加强调，而非换用更精确的形容词，口语化且显稚嫩
patterns.suggestion: 改用单一强形容词：crucial / pivotal / critical / indispensable

patterns.wrong: The reason is because...
patterns.issue: reason 与 because 语义重叠，中文『原因是……因为』直译
patterns.suggestion: The reason is that... / This is because... / 直接用 because 引导

patterns.wrong: repeat again / return back / advance forward / discuss together
patterns.issue: 动词已含方向或重复义，再加副词属同义重复
patterns.suggestion: 删去冗余副词：repeat / return / advance / discuss

patterns.wrong: In recent years, with the rapid development of society, ...
patterns.issue: 万能开头套话，信息量为零，几乎所有作文同构
patterns.suggestion: 用具体的时间、现象或数据切入：Since 2018, ... / The rise of X has...

patterns.wrong: first of all, last but not least, all in all, in a word
patterns.issue: 口语化套话堆砌，学术写作中显空泛
patterns.suggestion: 用 First / Finally / In sum / Overall，或直接以论点句替代

patterns.wrong: make a research / do a research
patterns.issue: research 作不可数名词，不与 make/do 搭配；研究本身用 conduct
patterns.suggestion: conduct research / carry out a study

patterns.wrong: discuss about the issue
patterns.issue: discuss 是及物动词，无需 about，中文『讨论关于』直译
patterns.suggestion: discuss the issue / debate the issue

patterns.wrong: learn knowledge / study knowledge
patterns.issue: knowledge 不能 learn，只能 acquire/gain/obtain；中文『学习知识』直译
patterns.suggestion: acquire knowledge / gain knowledge / learn about X

patterns.wrong: open the light / close the light
patterns.issue: 中文『开灯/关灯』直译，英语用 turn on/off
patterns.suggestion: turn on the light / switch off the light

patterns.wrong: How to say this in English?
patterns.issue: 疑问句缺主语，中文『怎么说』直译
patterns.suggestion: How do you say this in English? / What is the English for this?

patterns.wrong: I very like this theory.
patterns.issue: very 不能修饰动词，中文『很喜欢』直译
patterns.suggestion: I like this theory very much. / I am strongly drawn to this theory.

patterns.wrong: Although..., but...
patterns.issue: 英语中 although 与 but 不能同现，中文『虽然……但是』直译
patterns.suggestion: Although X, Y. / X, but Y.（二选一）

patterns.wrong: Because..., so...
patterns.issue: because 与 so 不能同现，中文『因为……所以』直译
patterns.suggestion: Because X, Y. / X, so Y.（二选一）

patterns.wrong: With the development of..., people's living standard has improved.
patterns.issue: 『随着……的发展』句式模板化，缺乏具体论据
patterns.suggestion: 以具体机制或证据开头：Falling infant mortality since 1990 reflects...

patterns.wrong: more and more students / more and more important
patterns.issue: 『越来越』直译，口语化且笼统
patterns.suggestion: a growing number of students / increasingly important / rising

patterns.wrong: Nowadays, ... / With the rapid development of modern society...
patterns.issue: Nowadays 起手为典型中式作文开头，信息空泛
patterns.suggestion: 用具体时间或语境：In contemporary Malaysia, ... / Since the 2020 pandemic, ...

patterns.wrong: give a suggestion / give an advice
patterns.issue: advice 不可数，不用 an；give 与 advice 搭配弱
patterns.suggestion: offer a suggestion / provide advice / recommend that...

patterns.wrong: pay attention on / focus in
patterns.issue: 介词搭配错误，应为 pay attention to / focus on
patterns.suggestion: pay attention to / focus on / concentrate on

patterns.wrong: according to my opinion
patterns.issue: according to 只引他人/来源，不引自己观点
patterns.suggestion: In my view / I believe / From my perspective

patterns.wrong: affect to / influence on the result（动词误用）
patterns.issue: affect 为及物动词，不加 to；influence 作动词亦及物
patterns.suggestion: affect the result / influence the result / have an influence on the result

patterns.wrong: play an important role in...（滥用）
patterns.issue: 该短语被无限套用，成为模板填充物，缺乏具体动词
patterns.suggestion: 改用具体动词：X drives / enables / constrains / shapes Y

patterns.wrong: Firstly, ... Secondly, ... Thirdly, ... Lastly, ...
patterns.issue: 序数连接词机械排列，段落沦为清单，缺乏逻辑层级
patterns.suggestion: 用逻辑关系连接：First / In addition / A further factor is / Finally，或省去显式标记

patterns.wrong: Moreover, ... Furthermore, ... In addition, ...（连续堆叠）
patterns.issue: 近义递进词连用，逻辑关系被稀释，读来重复
patterns.suggestion: 交替使用 Moreover / Also / Beyond this / Equally，并让句子本身承载递进

patterns.wrong: In conclusion, as mentioned above, to sum up, in a nutshell...
patterns.issue: 结论段引导语叠加，中文『综上所述』多次出现
patterns.suggestion: 一段一个收束表达：In sum / Overall / These findings suggest that...

patterns.wrong: On the one hand, ... On the other hand, ...（每段硬套）
patterns.issue: 强行平衡句式，为对仗而配对，观点其实并不对立
patterns.suggestion: 仅在真正对立/权衡时使用；否则用 However / Conversely / By contrast

patterns.wrong: It is worth noting that... / It should be noted that...（频繁使用）
patterns.issue: 提示语滥用，稀释信息密度，属典型论文腔填充
patterns.suggestion: 直接陈述该内容，或改用 Notably, / Importantly,

patterns.wrong: The problem was solved by us. / The data was analyzed by the researcher.
patterns.issue: 无必要使用被动语态，中文习惯『被……』迁移；主动更直接
patterns.suggestion: We solved the problem. / I analyzed the data.（方法学中被动可保留，但勿滥用）

patterns.wrong: The implementation of the optimization of the system is necessary.
patterns.issue: 名词化堆叠（implementation/optimization），动词被抽象化，句意模糊
patterns.suggestion: The system must be optimized. / We need to optimize the system.

patterns.wrong: There is a growing tendency for the majority of the students to...
patterns.issue: there be + 抽象名词 + of 结构，冗长绕口
patterns.suggestion: Most students now... / Students increasingly...

patterns.wrong: make an investigation of / conduct an analysis of / perform a comparison of
patterns.issue: 轻动词 + 名词化结构，啰嗦且书面冗余
patterns.suggestion: investigate / analyze / compare

patterns.wrong: a lot of / lots of / plenty of（学术语境）
patterns.issue: 口语化量词，学术写作不当
patterns.suggestion: many / numerous / a substantial number of / considerable

patterns.wrong: good / bad / nice / big / small（无具体性）
patterns.issue: 笼统评价词，缺乏学术精确度
patterns.suggestion: effective / beneficial / detrimental / substantial / negligible

patterns.wrong: get / got（学术语境）
patterns.issue: get 过于口语，且语义模糊
patterns.suggestion: obtain / receive / acquire / become / achieve

patterns.wrong: the society / the nature / the life（抽象名词误加冠词）
patterns.issue: 泛指抽象概念时误加定冠词，中文无冠词系统迁移
patterns.suggestion: society / nature / life（泛指）

patterns.wrong: many researches / several knowledges / various informations
patterns.issue: 不可数名词误用复数，中文名词无复数形态迁移
patterns.suggestion: much research / several studies / various pieces of information

patterns.wrong: a research / an evidence / a feedback
patterns.issue: 不可数名词误加不定冠词
patterns.suggestion: a study / a piece of evidence / some feedback

patterns.wrong: In this essay I will write about...（可写性陈述）
patterns.issue: 声明『我要写什么』而非直接写，属中文作文习惯
patterns.suggestion: 直接进入论证：This essay examines... 或直接陈述论点

patterns.wrong: I think maybe probably it is...
patterns.issue: 情态词叠加，立场含糊，显得不确定
patterns.suggestion: I argue that... / It is likely that... / The evidence suggests...

patterns.wrong: Everyone knows that... / As we all know, ...
patterns.issue: 诉诸常识，未提供引用，学术论证缺失
patterns.suggestion: 删除，或补充引用：As Smith (2020) demonstrates, ...

patterns.wrong: It is undoubted that... / There is no doubt that...
patterns.issue: 绝对化断言，缺乏限定语，易被质疑
patterns.suggestion: 加限定：The evidence strongly suggests that... / It is widely accepted that...

patterns.wrong: The company should be responsible for...（应然陈述未加论证）
patterns.issue: 直接下价值判断，缺中间论证步骤
patterns.suggestion: 补论证：Because X, the company bears responsibility for...

patterns.wrong: He didn't went / She have went
patterns.issue: 时态错误，助动词后误用动词过去式，中文无时态屈折迁移
patterns.suggestion: He didn't go / She has gone

patterns.wrong: In the past ten years, the technology change rapidly.
patterns.issue: 现在完成/一般时态与时间状语不匹配，主语单复数与动词不一致
patterns.suggestion: Over the past decade, technology has changed rapidly.

patterns.wrong: Please give me some good advices about my study.
patterns.issue: advice 不可数误加 s，study 单复数与语境不符，口语化请求
patterns.suggestion: I would welcome any advice on my studies.

patterns.wrong: The data shows that... / The data is...（单复数误判）
patterns.issue: data 在学术写作中常作复数（datum 的复数），部分语境已语法化为单数，需一致
patterns.suggestion: The data show that... / The dataset shows...（全篇统一）

patterns.wrong: I believe the theory which is proposed by Smith is very useful for us to solve the problem.
patterns.issue: 定语从句冗长、which is 冗余、very useful for us to 结构笨重
patterns.suggestion: Smith's theory offers a useful framework for solving the problem.

patterns.wrong: As a student, we should study hard.
patterns.issue: 主语人称不一致（As a student 单数 vs we 复数），中文泛指迁移
patterns.suggestion: As students, we should... / As a student, one should...
